title: Maximum Sum of Three Numbers Divisible by Three
summary: Given an integer array nums, select exactly three integers such that their sum is divisible by three.
statement: Given an integer array nums, select exactly three integers such that their sum is divisible by three. Return the maximum possible sum of these three integers. If no such triplet exists, return 0.
constraints: Return the maximum sum divisible by three, or zero if no eligible triple exists.
hints: Only each number’s remainder modulo three matters for feasibility.
A valid triple uses remainder counts 3-0-0, 0-3-0, 0-0-3, or 1-1-1.
Sort each remainder group descending and evaluate the four possible patterns.
For a fixed remainder pattern, choosing its largest members maximizes the sum; the patterns exhaust all divisible triples.
editorial: For a fixed remainder pattern, choosing its largest members maximizes the sum; the patterns exhaust all divisible triples.

tests.explanation: Choosing 4, 3, and 2 produces the maximum divisible sum, nine.
The only triple sums to three, which is divisible by three.
